msg.how2: Choose “Message” in the applicant header. It goes to the agency that submitted the application, or to Hangyul for direct applicants.
msg.how3: Replies arrive here and on the application. Internal notes stay inside your team.

login.asideLead: Hangyul applicants who submitted to your university, with the evidence for each published requirement in one place.
login.p1Text: What needs a decision first, then how this intake is doing.
login.p2Text: Requirement, applicant evidence and status in one table; documents open in place.
login.p3Text: Assign reviewers, request a standard document and mark administrative checks. None of these is a decision.
login.p4Text: Every chart opens the exact applicants it counts, with stated definitions.
login.asideFoot: Only applications submitted to your university are visible. Every export is audited.

security.title: Two-step verification
security.sub: After your password, you also enter a code from an authenticator app.

status.label: Status
status.required: Two-step verification is required for this account.
status.notEligible: Two-step verification isn't available for this account.
status.requiredOff: Your organization requires two-step verification. If you don't set it up now, you'll be asked to at your next sign-in.
status.resetNote: Lost your authenticator? Ask a Hangyul Univ administrator to reset two-step verification for you.
status.loadFailed: Couldn't load your two-step verification status.

challenge.title: Two-step verification
challenge.lede: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
challenge.recoveryLede: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you set up two-step verification. Each code works once.

enroll.title: Set up two-step verification
enroll.lede: Your account needs two-step verification before you can sign in.
enroll.step1: 1. Add this account to your authenticator app
enroll.step1Hint: In Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password or similar, choose to add an account and enter the setup key below. If the app is on this device, open the setup link instead.
enroll.step2: 2. Enter the 6-digit code the app shows

codes.title: Save your recovery codes
codes.lede: If you can't use your authenticator, each code signs you in once. They're shown only now, so keep them somewhere safe, such as a password manager.
codes.saved: I've saved these recovery codes somewhere safe
codes.fileNote: Each code can be used once.

regen.lede: Enter a current code from your authenticator app. Your old recovery codes will stop working.

err.invalid: That code isn't right. Check the code in your app and try again.
err.expired: This sign-in step has timed out. Please sign in again.
err.limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
err.limitedSoon: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
err.already: Two-step verification is already on for this account.
err.format: Enter the 6 digits from your app.
err.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

def.visaOutcome: Visa refused ÷ visa decisions (issued + refused) for applications to your university from this agency, in the selected intake. A refusal counts only when it was recorded on the student's visa case; unrecorded outcomes are listed separately, never assumed.
